channel_scope.reason: The pre-factor locator family still false-positives on known total3/4 negative controls and on multi-hit-root total2 surfaces.

pre_factor_gate.name: single_prefactor_hit_root
conditions: full materialized FFE surface has at least one selected root pair
selected public leaves expose exactly one distinct known hit root before factorization
pre_factor_gate.derived_from: post-144-151 diagnostic showing the broad pre-factor gate failed on a two-hit-root surface while the single-hit-root subgate was clean across total2 112-151

primary_root_policy.name: prefactor_unique_leaf_hit_root_first_target_hash
primary_root_policy.policy_identity_selection_rule: selected before 152-159 from the 144-151 handoff: with the single-hit-root gate, total2 112-151 was 13/13 preserving, zero false positives, 13/13 scan-below-rho, and 13/13 direct-below-rho
algorithm: read pre_factor_selected_hit_roots and pre_factor_selected_hit_root_pairs from the preregistered gate manifest
require exactly one distinct pre-factor selected hit root for promotion
rank Sage root-hyperplane candidates whose root is that pre-factor hit root first
fall back to target_root_hash among non-hit-root candidates
stop at the first public-zero root hyperplane
charge all selector work plus root-scan and direct-root accounting

baseline_root_policies.name: target_root_hash
baseline_root_policies.reason: previous static primary; preserving but too expensive on 128-135

promotion_condition: After generating the 152-159 total2 strict signature and pre-factor manifest, factor only surfaces with exactly one distinct pre-factor selected hit root and score prefactor_unique_leaf_hit_root_first_target_hash. Count as a total2 scan-positive promotion only if all selected single-hit-root surfaces are preserving, false-positive-free, and scan-below-rho. Count as a weaker direct-root positive if all are preserving, false-positive-free, and direct-below-rho.
non_claims: This does not promote total3/4 surfaces.
This does not claim end-to-end ECDLP recovery faster than Pollard rho.
This does not claim the dropped multi-hit-root surfaces are useless; they are outside this promoted gate.
